description: Feature set R. Engine-MVP first. R_U = unit|contract with non-empty tests. R_manual = R \ R_U.

requirements.title: ADL gate runnable; O(1) + R_manual explicit
requirements.acceptance: py scripts/adl_check.py exits 0; prints plugin out-degrees and R_manual

requirements.title: Shared table DTOs + per-plugin ports under contracts/
requirements.acceptance: contracts/shared holds Card, Action, Street, SeatOccupant.control manual|hosted, SeatView, LegalAction, HandResult; each plugin owns contracts/<id>/ only; no plugin imports another plugin

requirements.title: Engine plugins run without host SDKs
requirements.acceptance: src/{deck,evaluate,betting,dealer,bank,seat,runtime,app,config,auth,contracts} do not import src/hosts or cursor/dsh/codex/octokit packages

requirements.title: 52-card deck shuffle + deal hole/board via contracts
requirements.acceptance: DealPort deals 2 hole cards per seated player then 3-1-1 board; same seed is reproducible; no duplicate cards in a hand; no host import

requirements.title: 7-card hand rank for NLHE showdown
requirements.acceptance: EvaluatePort ranks 5-of-7; ties split pots via contracts; no import of betting/dealer

requirements.title: Legal actions + pot / to-call / min-raise
requirements.acceptance: BettingQuery returns fold/check/call/bet/raise/allin as legal; side pots later spec; config supplies blinds

requirements.title: Street FSM: preflop → flop → turn → river → showdown
requirements.acceptance: Dealer advances only via contracts ports; never imports deck/betting/evaluate

requirements.title: Stacks, post blinds, settle pot
requirements.acceptance: BankPort posts SB/BB from config; settle writes stack deltas; no host import

requirements.title: SeatView in / ActionIntent out — player port
requirements.acceptance: A seat never sees other hole cards; one githubLogin per seat; control is manual|hosted (same account, exclusive). Plugins do not import hosts

requirements.title: Compose wires plugins into a headless hand (no hosts)
requirements.acceptance: app/runtime sits fake githubLogins, plays one hand via contracts only; no src/hosts import

requirements.title: GitHub OAuth identity; table tokens for agents
requirements.acceptance: Human logs in via top-level GitHub OAuth. Hosting token is bound to the SAME githubLogin+seat (the player's own AI, not an opponent). Plugins do not import GitHub SDK. See doc/design/HOST-EMBED.md

requirements.title: Manual control: player finishes a hand by clicking H5
requirements.acceptance: control=manual, no hosting. Same GitHub account clicks through a hand on hosts/web. Agent act is rejected while manual.

requirements.title: Hosting: same GitHub account delegates the seat to their AI
requirements.acceptance: Player toggles control=hosted on THEIR seat. H5 clicks rejected (except take-back). Agent with that account's table token finishes the hand via act. Take-back restores manual. Not a second-seat opponent. Cursor is one hosting client.

requirements.title: One-time token grant if this GitHub account starred the repo
requirements.acceptance: Claim button: GET /user/starred/{owner}/{repo} with the user's token. 204 + never claimed → BankPort.grant once via compose. 404 or already claimed → no credit. bank/plugins do not import GitHub. Amount in config. No unstar clawback in MVP. See doc/design/STAR-GRANT.md
